definitions.explanation: Slang term for someone who has difficulty communicating or socializing with others. Abbreviation of コミュニケーション{障害|しょうがい} (communication disorder), but used casually and often self-deprecatingly.

examples.japanese: {私|わたし}はコミュ{障|しょう}だから、{初対面|しょたいめん}の{人|ひと}と{話|はな}すのが{苦手|にがて}。
examples.english: I'm socially awkward, so I have trouble talking to people I've just met.

examples.japanese: コミュ{障|しょう}でも{働|はたら}きやすい{仕事|しごと}を{探|さが}している。
examples.english: I'm looking for a job that's easy to work at even if you're socially awkward.

examples.japanese: 「コミュ{障|しょう}」は{自虐|じぎゃく}ネタとしてよく{使|つか}われる。
examples.english: "Komyushou" is often used as self-deprecating humor.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY: Abbreviation of コミュニケーション{障害|しょうがい} (communication disorder). The clinical term has been adopted as casual slang with a much broader, less clinical meaning.

REGISTER: Casual/Slang
Primarily used among young people. Often used self-deprecatingly. The clinical origin means this term should be used carefully, as it can be insensitive to people with actual communication disorders.

USAGE NOTES:
・Very commonly used for self-description
・Can be seen as insensitive when used to describe others
・Often appears in discussions about social anxiety or introversion
・Sometimes written as コミュしょう with hiragana

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・コミュ{障|しょう}{気味|ぎみ} (somewhat socially awkward)
・{重度|じゅうど}のコミュ{障|しょう} (severely socially awkward - humorous)
・コミュ{障|しょう}を{克服|こくふく}する (to overcome social awkwardness)

RELATED TERMS:
・{人見知|ひとみし}り: shy around strangers (more neutral)
・{内向的|ないこうてき}: introverted (formal, clinical)
・コミュ{力|りょく}: communication skills (abbreviated)
